```{r}
#make a library for pycroquet exact mapping
evopreq <- "CGCGGTTCTATCTAGTTACGCGTTAAACCAACTAGAATTTTTTT"
scaffold <- "gtttaagagCTATGCTGGAAACAGCATAGCAAGTTTAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGCACCGAGTCGgtgc"

KRAS_pyc_forward_151  <-
  lib %>%
  select(id, gRNA, extension) %>%
  mutate(sgrna_seqs = paste0(gRNA, scaffold, extension, evopreq)) %>% #concatamer
    mutate(sgrna_seqs = str_to_upper(sgrna_seqs)) %>% #upper case
  mutate(sgrna_seqs = substr(sgrna_seqs, 0, 151)) %>% #151 bp reads
  mutate(len = nchar(sgrna_seqs))

KRAS_pyc_forward_151 %>%
  write.csv("KRAS_pyc_forward_151.csv")
```

```{r}
#find duplicates in the pycroquet mapping library
```

```{r}
#make a library for pycroquet exact mapping dual guide (WT)
pycroquet_paired <-
lib %>%
  select(id, Twist_oligo, Twist_length) %>%
  mutate(read1 = substr(Twist_oligo, 27, 177)) %>%
  mutate(length_read1 = str_count(read1)) %>%
  mutate(read2 = substr(Twist_oligo, (Twist_length-78), (Twist_length-25))) %>%
  mutate(length_read2 = str_count(read2)) %>%
  mutate(sgrna_ids = paste0(id, "|", id)) %>%
  mutate(sgrna_seqs = paste0(read1, "|", read2)) %>%
  mutate(sgrna_seqs = str_to_upper(sgrna_seqs))

pycroquet_paired 

pycroquet_paired %>%
  write.csv("pycroquet_KRAS_paired.csv")
```

```{r}
#define the mutated sequence
target_seq <- 
  lib %>% 
  mutate(target_seq = ifelse(sensor_orientation == "forward", rc_sensor, sensor)) %>%
   select(id, target_seq, sensor_orientation, sensor, rc_sensor, extension, Twist_oligo, sequence_name) 

#function to make a list of intended sensor edits
replace_with_mutation <- function(target, ext) {
  if (is.na(target) || is.na(ext)) return(NA_character_)
  
  ext_len <- nchar(ext)
  target_len <- nchar(target)
  
  if (target_len < ext_len) return(NA_character_)
  
  ext_upper <- toupper(ext)
  
  for (i in 1:(target_len - ext_len + 1)) {
    sub_seq <- substr(target, i, i + ext_len - 1)
    
    # Count number of mismatches
    mismatches <- sum(strsplit(sub_seq, "")[[1]] != strsplit(ext_upper, "")[[1]])
    
    if (mismatches == 1) {
      return(paste0(
        substr(target, 1, i - 1),
        ext,
        substr(target, i + ext_len, target_len)
      ))
    }
  }
  return(NA_character_)  # No match found
}

# write the expected mutation in the sensor sequence
target_seq <-
  target_seq %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(mutated_target_seq = replace_with_mutation(target_seq, extension)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  select(sequence_name, target_seq, mutated_target_seq, extension, sensor, id)  %>%
  rename(WT_sensor = target_seq) %>%
  mutate(mutated_sensor = str_to_upper(mutated_target_seq)) %>%
  mutate(WT_sensor = ifelse(str_detect(id, "non-targeting"), sensor, WT_sensor)) %>%
  mutate(mutated_sensor = ifelse(str_detect(id, "non-targeting"), sensor, mutated_sensor)) %>%
  select(sequence_name, WT_sensor, mutated_sensor, id) %>%
  distinct()

target_seq
```

```{r}
#LUCA library -  make two separate libraries for  alignment - one with WT sensor and one with intended edit
WT_sequences <-
  target_seq %>%
  select(id, sequence_name, WT_sensor) %>%
  mutate(WT_sensor = str_to_upper((WT_sensor))) %>%
    select(id, sequence_name, WT_sensor) %>%
  distinct()

mutant_sequences <- 
  target_seq %>%
  select(id, sequence_name, mutated_sensor) %>%
  mutate(mutated_sensor = str_to_upper((mutated_sensor))) %>%
    select(id, sequence_name, mutated_sensor) %>%
  distinct()

WT_sequences <-
  WT_sequences %>% rename(sensor_LUCA = WT_sensor)

mutant_sequences <-
  mutant_sequences %>% rename(sensor_LUCA = mutated_sensor)

WT_lib <- left_join(lib, WT_sequences)
mutant_lib <- left_join(lib, mutant_sequences)

WT_lib <- 
  WT_lib %>%
  mutate(extension = str_to_upper(extension)) %>%
    mutate(Twist_oligo = str_to_upper(Twist_oligo)) %>%
  select(id, gRNA, extension, sensor_LUCA) %>%
  distinct()

mutant_lib <- 
  mutant_lib %>%
  mutate(extension = str_to_upper(extension)) %>%
    mutate(Twist_oligo = str_to_upper(Twist_oligo)) %>%
  select(id, gRNA, extension, sensor_LUCA) %>%
  distinct()

write_tsv(WT_lib, "WT_KRAS_lib.tsv")
write_tsv(mutant_lib, "mutant_KRAS_lib.tsv")
```

```{r}
#pycroquet 151 forward read - gRNA + scaffold + extension
# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "pycroquet_151", pattern = "\\.counts\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  df <- read_tsv(file, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-`#id`, -unique_guide, -gene_pair_id, -sgrna_seqs) %>%
    rename(id = sgrna_ids)
  
  # Get the current count column name (not "id") and generate new name
  count_col <- setdiff(names(df), "id")
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>% str_remove("\\.counts$")
  new_colname <- paste0(sample_name, "_pyc_reads")
  
  df %>% rename(!!new_colname := all_of(count_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
reads <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "id")

reads
```

```{r}
#pycroquet 151 forward read and 54 bp reverse paired read - gRNA + scaffold + extension + sensor
# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "auto_pycroquet_paired", pattern = "\\.counts\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  df <- read_tsv(file, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-sgrna_ids, -unique_guide, -gene_pair_id, -sgrna_seqs) %>%
    rename(id = `#id`)
  
  # Get the current count column name (not "id") and generate new name
  count_col <- setdiff(names(df), "id")
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>% str_remove("\\.counts$")
  new_colname <- paste0(sample_name, "_pyc_reads")
  
  df %>% rename(!!new_colname := all_of(count_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
sensor_reads <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "id")

sensor_reads
```

```{r}
# generate % editing for each value
# Function to add editing % for a single var
add_editing_percentage <- function(df, var_prefix) {
  wt_col <- paste0(var_prefix, "_dual_PE_pyc_reads")
  mut_col <- paste0(var_prefix, "_dual_PE_mut_pyc_reads")
  new_col <- paste0(var_prefix, "_editing")

  if (!all(c(wt_col, mut_col) %in% names(df))) {
    warning(paste("Skipping:", var_prefix, "- missing WT or mut columns."))
    return(df)
  }

  df[[new_col]] <- ifelse(
    df[[wt_col]] + df[[mut_col]] == 0,
    NA,
    df[[mut_col]] / (df[[wt_col]] + df[[mut_col]]) * 100
  )

  return(df)
}

# Function to detect all var prefixes and apply percentage function
add_all_editing_percentages <- function(df) {
  wt_cols <- grep("_dual_PE_pyc_reads$", names(df), value = TRUE)
  vars <- sub("_dual_PE_pyc_reads$", "", wt_cols)

  for (var_prefix in vars) {
    df <- add_editing_percentage(df, var_prefix)
  }

  return(df)
}

join_data <- 
  add_all_editing_percentages(join_data)

join_data %>%
  select(contains("editing"))
```

```{r}
# make an average editing rate for each condition
r1_cols <- names(join_data)[
  str_detect(names(join_data), "R1") & 
  str_detect(names(join_data), "editing")
]

# Loop through each R1 column to calculate average with corresponding R2
for (r1_col in r1_cols) {
  # Extract the base variable name by removing "_R1" but keeping "_editing"
  base_name <- str_remove(r1_col, "_R1")
  
  # Construct corresponding R2 and output average column names
  r2_col  <- str_replace(r1_col, "_R1", "_R2")
  avg_col <- str_replace(base_name, "_editing$", "_average_editing")
  
  # Check that the R2 column exists
  if (r2_col %in% names(join_data)) {
    join_data <- join_data %>%
      mutate(!!avg_col := rowMeans(across(all_of(c(r1_col, r2_col))), na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    warning(paste("R2 column not found for:", base_name))
  }
}

join_data %>%
  select(contains("editing"))
```

```{r}
# normalise editing to plasmid
# Reference column to subtract
reference_col <- "Plasmid_8132stdy_editing"

# Check that the reference column exists
if (!reference_col %in% names(join_data)) {
  stop("Reference column 'Plasmid_8132stdy_editing' not found in the dataset.")
}

# Get all columns ending in _average_editing
editing_cols <- names(join_data)[str_detect(names(join_data), "_editing$")]

# Loop through and create corrected columns
for (editing_cols in editing_cols) {
  if (editing_cols != reference_col) {
    corrected_col <- str_replace(editing_cols, "_editing$", "_corrected_editing")
    
    join_data <- join_data %>%
      mutate(!!corrected_col := .data[[editing_cols]] - .data[[reference_col]])
  }
}

join_data %>%
  select(contains ("_corrected_editing"))
```

```{r}
#create an estimate of discrepancy between editing + WT and unmapped/unintended edits

# Get all WT columns
wt_cols <- names(join_data)[str_detect(names(join_data), "_dual_PE_pyc_reads")]

# Loop over them and create the new _summed_counts columns
for (wt_col in wt_cols) {
  mut_col <- str_replace(wt_col, "_dual_PE_pyc_reads", "_dual_PE_mut_pyc_reads")
  total_col <- str_replace(wt_col, "_dual_PE_pyc_reads", "_summed_counts")
  
  if (mut_col %in% names(join_data)) {
    join_data[[total_col]] <- join_data[[wt_col]] + join_data[[mut_col]]
  } else {
    warning(paste("Missing matching mut column for:", wt_col))
  }
}

join_data <-
  join_data %>%
  select(!contains("_summed_counts_RPM"))

join_data %>%
  select(contains("summed")) 
```

```{r}
#now calculate unintended editing (difference between summed WT and mut counts and the total counts with just guide + extension mapped)

# Find all _summed_counts columns
summed_cols <- names(join_data)[str_detect(names(join_data), "_summed_counts")]
summed_cols

# Loop through each and compute unintended editing
for (summed_col in summed_cols) {
  # Get base name (remove _summed_counts)
  base_name <- str_replace(summed_col, "_summed_counts", "")
  
  # Original total counts column (e.g., gene1_counts)
  original_col <- paste0(base_name, "_pyc_reads")
  
  # Name for the new unintended_editing column
  unintended_col <- paste0(base_name, "_unintended_editing")
  
  if (original_col %in% names(join_data)) {
    join_data[[unintended_col]] <- 
      ((join_data[[original_col]] - join_data[[summed_col]]) / 
         join_data[[original_col]]) * 100
  } else {
    warning(paste("Missing original counts column for:", summed_col))
  }
}

join_data %>%
  select(contains("unintended"))
```

```{r}
#make a replicate versus replicate heatmap for the readcoutns from pycroquet forward

# 1) pick columns: *_pyc_reads AND containing _R1_ or _R2_
read_cols <- names(join_data_filtered) %>%
  (\(x) x[str_detect(x, "_pyc_reads$") & str_detect(x, "_R[12]_") & (str_detect(x, "dual")==FALSE) & (str_detect(x, "sec")==FALSE)])()

# 2) build pretty labels + ordering (group by sample, then R1/R2)
meta <- tibble(col = read_cols) %>%
  mutate(
    rep = str_match(col, "_R([12])_")[, 2],
    sample = col %>%
      str_replace("_R[12]_", "_") %>%
                str_remove("_end") %>%
            str_replace("2863", "2865") %>%
      str_remove("_pyc_reads$"),
    label = paste0(str_replace_all(sample, "_", " "), " R", rep)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample, as.integer(rep))

# 3) numeric matrix + correlations
mat <- join_data_filtered %>%
  select(all_of(meta$col)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  as.matrix()

cor_mat <- cor(mat, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# rename rows/cols with pretty labels
colnames(cor_mat) <- meta$label
rownames(cor_mat) <- meta$label

# ---- 4) long form + keep LOWER triangle incl diagonal ----
cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rename(y = Var1, x = Var2, r = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    x = factor(x, levels = meta$label),
    y = factor(y, levels = meta$label),
    ix = as.integer(x),
    iy = as.integer(y)
  ) %>%
  filter(iy >= ix)

# 5) plot: diagonal/lower-triangle heatmap
plot1<-ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(r), "", sprintf("%.2f", r))), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red",
                      limits = c(0.2, 1.0), oob = squish) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "left") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
plot1
ggsave("prime_reads_Pearson.eps", width = 8, height = 8, path ="./figures_export")
```

```{r}
# plot corrected average editing rates over time (no non-targeting)
plot_data <- join_data_filtered %>%
  select(contains("_average_corrected_editing")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "condition",
    values_to = "corrected_editing"
  ) %>%
  # Optionally clean the condition names
  mutate(condition = str_remove(condition, "_average_corrected_editing$")) %>%
    # Remove NA values
  distinct()

#rename conditions for the figure
plot_data <-
  plot_data %>%
  mutate(condition = ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_T0", "T0 PE", 
                             ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_Lib_T0", "T0 PE", 
                            ifelse(condition == "A427_Parental_Lib_T0", "T0 parental",
                                    ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_Lib_T1", "T1 PE",
                                                  ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end", "PE-FLARE",
                                                          ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_Lib_MRTX_end", "MRTX1133",
                                                                 ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_Lib_ACBI3_end", "ACBI3",
                                                                      ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_Lib_RMC_end", "RMC-6236",
                                                                             ifelse(condition == "A427_PE_Lib_BI_2863_end", "BI-2865",
                                                                              condition))))))))))

condition_order <- c(
"T0 parental",	
"T0 PE",
"T1 PE",
"PE-FLARE",
"RMC-6236",	
"ACBI3", 
"BI-2865",
"MRTX1133"
)

# Prepare the data by ordering condition (time)
plot_data <- 
  plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_order)  # Apply factor level order
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(corrected_editing)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition))
```

```{r}
#t-test the control versus the PE-FLARE editing condition

PEFLARE_edits <-
  plot_data %>%
  filter(condition == "PE-FLARE") %>%
  select(corrected_editing)

control_edits <-
  plot_data %>%
  filter(condition == "RMC-6236") %>%
  select(corrected_editing)

stats1 <- t.test(control_edits, PEFLARE_edits, paired = FALSE, alternative = c("two.sided"))
stats1

# Make a nice label for the plot
p_lab <- 
  paste0("italic(P) == ", format(stats1$p.value, digits = 2, scientific = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# PE Coverage Estimation
#filter  data to include only non-synonymous variants - no editing filter
heat_map <- 
  join_data_filtered %>%
  filter(gene == "KRAS") %>%
  arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  filter(mutation_type != "synonymous") %>%
    distinct()

# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 200 residues)
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position))

#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table with the gRNAs by Protein_Position
Coverage <-
  left_join(Protein, heat_map)
Coverage

#identify the number of missing amino acids (NA gRNA)
Missing <- 
  Coverage %>%
  filter(is.na(mutation) == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::count()

#calculate the % coverage by non-synonymous amino acid mutations with CBE and ABE
(Length-Missing)/Length*100

#summarise the BE coverage data with a histogram
plot1 <- ggplot(Coverage, aes(x=amino_acid_position, fill = mutation_type)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
theme_classic()

#print the plot
plot1

write.csv(Coverage, "coverage_PE.csv")
```

```{r}
#heatmap showing na values and mean value - scaled by ROW

# Select only columns ending in "z_score" and amino_acid_position
df_numeric <- heat_map %>%
  select(amino_acid_position, ends_with("T0_Par_average_zscore")) %>%
  group_by(amino_acid_position) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = FALSE)) %>%  # Keep NAs
  arrange(amino_acid_position)

# --- Make sure we include ALL amino acid positions (1 to Length) ---
Length <- 189
all_positions <- tibble(amino_acid_position = 1:Length)

df_numeric <- all_positions %>%
  left_join(df_numeric, by = "amino_acid_position")

# Convert to matrix
df_matrix <- as.matrix(df_numeric %>% column_to_rownames("amino_acid_position"))

# Ensure columns are ordered numerically
df_matrix <- df_matrix[, order(as.numeric(colnames(df_matrix)))]

# Transpose the matrix so positions are on x-axis
df_matrix <- t(df_matrix)

# Generate the heatmap
plot1 <- pheatmap(
  df_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_cols = FALSE,   # Keep AA positions in order
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main = "Heatmap of KRAS",
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(200),
  border_color = NA,
  na_col = "grey"   # <--- This makes NA values appear grey
)
plot1
```

```{r}
#filter out repeated pegRNA variants
sc_lib_filtered <-
  sc_lib %>%
  group_by(sequence_name) %>%
  mutate(row_in_group = row_number()) %>%   # rank within group
  filter(row_in_group <= 2) %>%             # keep first 2
  select(-row_in_group) %>%                 # optional: remove helper column
  ungroup()

#filter out repeated pegRNA variants with mut1/2/3/4...
sc_lib_filtered <- 
sc_lib_filtered %>%
mutate(sort = str_replace(sequence_name, "mut1", "")) %>%
  mutate(sort = str_replace(sort, "mut2", "")) %>%
    mutate(sort = str_replace(sort, "mut3", "")) %>%
      mutate(sort = str_replace(sort, "mut4", "")) %>%
      mutate(sort = str_replace(sort, "mut5", "")) %>%
  group_by(sort) %>%
  mutate(row_in_group = row_number()) %>%   # rank within group
  filter(row_in_group <= 2) %>%             # keep first 2
  select(-row_in_group) %>%                 # optional: remove helper column
  ungroup()

#bind rows with the rest of the pegRNAs
sc_lib_filtered <- 
  bind_rows(sc_lib_filtered, non_targeting, resistance_KRAS_synonymous, validation) %>%
  distinct()

#filter out repeated pegRNA extensions
  sc_lib_filtered<- 
    sc_lib_filtered %>%
  group_by(extension) %>%
  mutate(row_in_group = row_number()) %>%   # rank within group
  filter(row_in_group <= 1) %>%             # keep first 1
  select(-row_in_group) %>%                 # optional: remove helper column
  ungroup()

sc_lib_filtered %>%
  count(mutation_type)

sc_lib_filtered %>%
  arrange(gene)
```

```{r}
#add lib_class
sc_lib_filtered <-
  sc_lib_filtered %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% editing$id, "editing", "" )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% resistance$id, "resistance", lib_class )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% resistance_KRAS$id, "resistance", lib_class )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% deleterious$id, "deleterious", lib_class )) %>%
    mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% synonymous$id, "synonymous", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% non_coding$id, "non_coding", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% tumour_suppressors$id, "tumour_suppressors", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% non_targeting$id, "non_targeting", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% resistance_KRAS_synonymous$id, "validation", lib_class )) %>%
      mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% validation$id, "validation", lib_class )) %>%
        mutate(lib_class = ifelse(id %in% RBM10$id, "RBM10", lib_class ))
```

```{r}
#read in protvar data for KRAS
protvar_KRAS <- as_tibble(read.csv("P01116-fun-pop-str.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))

protvar_KRAS <-
  protvar_KRAS %>%
  rename(gene = Gene) %>%
    rename(amino_acid_position = Amino_acid_position) %>%
      rename(mutation_type = Consequences) %>%
  rename(protvar_mutation = Amino_acid_change)

# Three-letter to one-letter lookup table
aa_dict <- c(
  Ala = "A", Arg = "R", Asn = "N", Asp = "D",
  Cys = "C", Gln = "Q", Glu = "E", Gly = "G",
  His = "H", Ile = "I", Leu = "L", Lys = "K",
  Met = "M", Phe = "F", Pro = "P", Ser = "S",
  Thr = "T", Trp = "W", Tyr = "Y", Val = "V"
)

protvar_KRAS <- 
  protvar_KRAS %>%
  mutate(
    # Split mutation into ref and alt
    ref_aa = str_split(protvar_mutation, "/", simplify = TRUE)[,1],
    alt_aa = str_split(protvar_mutation, "/", simplify = TRUE)[,2],
    # Convert to one-letter using the dictionary
    ref_aa1 = aa_dict[ref_aa],
    alt_aa1 = aa_dict[alt_aa],
    # Build mutation string like M1I
    mutation = paste0(ref_aa1, amino_acid_position, alt_aa1)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

left_join(join_data_filtered_editing, protvar_KRAS) %>%
  filter(is.na(Diseases_associated_with_variant) == FALSE) %>%
    filter(Diseases_associated_with_variant != "N/A") %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, mutation, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_T0_Par_average_zscore, Diseases_associated_with_variant, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing) %>%
  arrange(L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_T0_Par_average_zscore)

protvar_join <-
  left_join(join_data_filtered_editing, protvar_KRAS) %>%
  distinct()

protvar_join
```

```{r}
# crispresso2 Pooled prepare files quantifying between pos 3 and position 48 of the sensor and taking fastqs with 50 reads
#this is in line with the max extension boundaries before and after the edit in the sensor

scaffold <- str_to_upper("gtttaagagCTATGCTGGAAACAGCATAGCAAGTTTAAATAAGGCTAGTCCGTTATCAACTTGAAAAAGTGGCACCGAGTCGgtgc")

evopreQ_term <- "CGCGGTTCTATCTAGTTACGCGTTAAACCAACTAGAATTTTTTT"

join_data %>%
  select(sensor, extension_before_variant) %>%
  mutate(nt = str_count(extension_before_variant)) %>%
  arrange((nt))

join_data %>%
  select(sensor, extension_after_variant) %>%
  mutate(nt = str_count(extension_after_variant)) %>%
  arrange((nt))

amplicons_files <- join_data %>%
  rename(amplicon_name = id) %>%
  mutate(amplicon_seq = paste0(gRNA, scaffold, extension, evopreQ_term, sensor_LUCA_WT)) %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq = gRNA) %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq = extension) %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_scaffold_seq = "GGCACCGAGUCGGUGC") %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_override_prime_edited_ref_seq = paste0(gRNA, scaffold, extension, evopreQ_term, sensor_LUCA_mut)) %>%
  mutate(quantification_window_coordinates = paste0((105+extension_length+44+2), "-", (105+extension_length+44+48))) %>%
  select(amplicon_name, amplicon_seq, prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq, prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq, prime_editing_pegRNA_scaffold_seq, prime_editing_override_prime_edited_ref_seq, quantification_window_coordinates) %>%
  distinct()

#filter out non-targeting pegRNAs
amplicons_files <-
amplicons_files %>%
  filter(str_detect(amplicon_name, "non-target") == FALSE)
amplicons_files

#CRISPRessoPooled (CRISPResso2) wants to reverse comp the extension sequence!
amplicons_files <-
  amplicons_files %>%
  mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq = str_to_upper(reverseComplement(prime_editing_pegRNA_extension_seq))) %>%
    mutate(prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq = str_to_upper(reverseComplement(prime_editing_pegRNA_spacer_seq)))

amplicons_files %>%
  write_tsv("amplicons_files.tsv")
```

```{r}
# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 796 residues)
Length <- 189

  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.integer(amino_acid_position))

Protein
```

```{r}
#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table twith the gRNAs by Protein_Position
#Amino acid positions impute NA to 0
B_CTRL_prime <-
  left_join(Protein, B_CTRL_prime) %>%
  mutate(min_score_CTRL = ifelse(is.na(min_score_CTRL)==TRUE, 0, min_score_CTRL))
  
B_ACBI3_prime <-
  left_join(Protein, B_ACBI3_prime) %>%
  mutate(max_score_ACBI3 = ifelse(is.na(max_score_ACBI3)==TRUE, 0, max_score_ACBI3))

B_RMC_prime <-
  left_join(Protein, B_RMC_prime) %>%
  mutate(max_score_RMC = ifelse(is.na(max_score_RMC)==TRUE, 0, max_score_RMC))
```

```{r}
PTEN_counts <- as_tibble(read.csv("PTEN_mutationsOct30_10_17_56_2025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))%>% 
  rename(amino_acid_position = Position) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_remove(AA.Mutation, "p.")) %>%
  rename(exact_COSMIC_count = Count) %>%
  select(!c(CDS.Mutation, Type, AA.Mutation)) %>%
  mutate(gene = "PTEN") %>%
    filter(is.na(amino_acid_position) == FALSE) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_replace_all(mutation, "\\*", "STOP")) %>%
  distinct()

BRAF_counts <- as_tibble(read.csv("BRAF_mutationsOct30_10_15_31_2025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))%>% 
  rename(amino_acid_position = Position) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_remove(AA.Mutation, "p.")) %>%
  rename(exact_COSMIC_count = Count) %>%
  select(!c(CDS.Mutation, Type, AA.Mutation)) %>%
  mutate(gene = "BRAF") %>%
    filter(is.na(amino_acid_position) == FALSE) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_replace_all(mutation, "\\*", "STOP")) %>%
  distinct()

KRAS_counts <- as_tibble(read.csv("KRAS_mutationsThuNov2713_05_092025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))%>% 
  rename(amino_acid_position = Position) %>%
  mutate(mutation = str_remove(AA.Mutation, "p.")) %>%
  rename(exact_COSMIC_count = Count) %>%
  select(!c(CDS.Mutation, Type, AA.Mutation)) %>%
  mutate(gene = "KRAS") %>%
    filter(is.na(amino_acid_position) == FALSE) %>%
    mutate(mutation = str_replace_all(mutation, "\\*", "STOP")) %>%
  distinct()

counts <- 
  bind_rows(NF1_counts, EGFR_counts, ALK_counts, TP53_counts, ARID1A_counts, KEAP1_counts, PTEN_counts, BRAF_counts, KRAS_counts)

#left_join
join_data_filtered_plotting <- 
  left_join(join_data_filtered_plotting, counts)

join_data_filtered_plotting

#add the totals counts together for multiple mutations of the same residue
join_data_filtered_plotting <- 
  join_data_filtered_plotting %>%
  group_by(mutation, gene) %>%
  mutate(total_exact_COSMIC_count = sum(exact_COSMIC_count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#plot dot plot faceted - mutation hits for TP53, BRAF, ERBB2,PI3K
plot1 <- ggplot(subset(df_long_filtered, gene %in% c("TP53", "BRAF")),
                aes(x = mutation_id, y = drug, size = editing)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = z_score), shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.15) +
  ylab("")+
      scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_map, expand = c(0, 0)) +  # <-- show mutation text
  facet_wrap(~gene, scales = "free", nrow =1) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 8)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, name = "z-score") +
  theme_classic() +

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  # Add comsic bar

            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            height = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "COSMIC count",

  labels = scales::comma_format()) +

#add Cas9 bar

  geom_tile(data = cas9_bar %>% filter(gene %in% c("TP53", "BRAF")),

scale_fill_gradient(
```

```{r}
  #check Y96 editing (resistance to KRAS G12C inhibitors)
  join_data_filtered %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, mutation, id, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_MRTX_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_RMC_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_T0_Par_average_zscore, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing) %>%
  filter(gene=="KRAS") %>%
  filter(amino_acid_position == "96") %>%
  arrange(desc(A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing))
  
   #check Y64 editing (resistance to KRAS inhibitors)
  join_data_filtered %>%
  select(gene, amino_acid_position, mutation, mutation_type, id, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_MRTX_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_RMC_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_T0_Par_average_zscore, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing) %>%
  filter(gene=="KRAS") %>%
  filter(amino_acid_position == "64") %>%
    filter(mutation_type == "missense") %>%
  arrange(desc(A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing))
```

```{r}
#compute distances of drug to each KRAS residue in PyMol crystal structures 9BG0 and 8QVU

  as_tibble(read.csv("ACBI3_distances.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))

RMC_distances <-
RMC_distances %>%
  mutate(gene = "KRAS") %>%
  dplyr::rename(amino_acid_position = resi) %>%
  dplyr::rename(RMC6236_distance = min_sidechain_distance) %>%
  select(!chain)
  
ACBI3_distances <-
ACBI3_distances %>%
  mutate(gene = "KRAS") %>%
  dplyr::rename(amino_acid_position = resi) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ACBI3_distance = min_sidechain_distance) %>%
  select(!chain)

#join distances together into one table
drug_distances <-
  left_join(RMC_distances, ACBI3_distances)
```

```{r}
#validation sc screen analysis
#pycroquet 151 forward read - gRNA + scaffold + extension
# List all .counts.tsv files in the /results directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "pycroquet_KRASsc_valid_lib_151bp", pattern = "\\.counts\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read and prepare each file
read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  df <- read_tsv(file, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-`#id`, -unique_guide, -gene_pair_id, -sgrna_seqs) %>%
    rename(id = sgrna_ids)
  
  # Get the current count column name (not "id") and generate new name
  count_col <- setdiff(names(df), "id")
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>% str_remove("\\.counts$")
  new_colname <- paste0(sample_name, "_valid_pyc_reads")
  
  df %>% rename(!!new_colname := all_of(count_col))
}

# Join all tables by 'id'
validation_reads <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "id")

validation_reads
```

```{r}
#average reads
# 1) identify columns like: <prefix>_R1_L1_<suffix> / <prefix>_R2_L1_<suffix>
meta <- tibble(col = names(validation_screen)) %>%
  mutate(
    prefix = str_match(col, "^(.*)_R[12]_L1_")[, 2],
    suffix = str_match(col, "^.*_R[12]_L1_(.*)$")[, 2]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(prefix), !is.na(suffix)) %>%
  group_by(prefix, suffix) %>%
  summarise(cols = list(col), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(lengths(cols) == 2)

# 2) add averaged columns (does not delete R1/R2)
validation_screen <- purrr::reduce(
  .x = seq_len(nrow(meta)),
  .init = validation_screen,
  .f = \(df, i) {
    cols <- meta$cols[[i]]
    new_name <- paste(meta$prefix[i], "average", meta$suffix[i], sep = "_")  # drops R? + L1

    df %>%
      mutate(!!new_name := rowMeans(as.matrix(pick(all_of(cols))), na.rm = TRUE))
  }
)
validation_screen
```

```{r}
#make an output files with editing an zscores for analysis for the single cell RNA seq data
sc_zscores <-
validation_screen %>%
select(
    -contains("H647"),
    -contains("predict_rank"),
    -contains("length"),
    -contains("extension1_in_sensor"),
    -contains("extension2_in_sensor"),
    -contains("_RPM"), 
    -contains("pridict_rank"),
    -contains("Twist_oligo"),
    -contains("R1_L1_PE_valid_pyc_reads"),
    -contains("R2_L1_PE_valid_pyc_reads"),
    -contains("_average_PE_valid_pyc_reads"),
    -contains("genomic_context"), 
    -contains("sensor"),
    -contains("rc_sensor"),
    -contains("sensor_orientation"),
    -contains("extension_before_variant"),
    -contains("extension_after_variant"),
    -contains("rc_gRNA")
    )

sc_zscores <-
sc_zscores %>%
  mutate(LOW_COUNTS_validation_screen = ifelse((Plasmid_scKRAS_PE_pool_L1_PE_valid_pyc_reads <read_threshold), TRUE, FALSE))

sc_zscores <-
sc_zscores %>%
  mutate(LOW_COUNTS_primary_screen = ifelse((Plasmid_8132stdy_pyc_reads <read_threshold), TRUE, FALSE))

sc_zscores
```

```{r}
#redefine the lib_class field based on the validation screen and RMC condition
sc_zscores <-
  sc_zscores %>%
  mutate(lib_class = NA)

sc_zscores <-
sc_zscores %>%
  mutate(lib_class = ifelse(A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing >= 60 & LOW_COUNTS_validation_screen == FALSE &  LOW_COUNTS_primary_screen == FALSE, "editing",
                                                                  ifelse(mutation_type == "non_coding", "non_coding",
lib_class)))

sc_zscores <-
sc_zscores %>%
  mutate(lib_class = ifelse(L2FC_A427PE_RMC6236_valid_plasmid_average_zscore >1 & L2FC_A427_PE_RMC_T0_Par_average_zscore >1 & LOW_COUNTS_validation_screen == FALSE &  LOW_COUNTS_primary_screen == FALSE, "resistance",
                               ifelse(L2FC_A427PE_Control_valid_plasmid_average_zscore < -1 & L2FC_A427PE_RMC6236_valid_plasmid_average_zscore < -1 & L2FC_PC9PE_Control_valid_plasmid_average_zscore < -1 & LOW_COUNTS_validation_screen == FALSE &  LOW_COUNTS_primary_screen == FALSE, "deleterious",
                                      lib_class))) 

sc_zscores <-
sc_zscores %>%
  mutate(lib_class = ifelse(L2FC_A427PE_Control_valid_plasmid_average_zscore > 1 & L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_T0_Par_average_zscore > 1 & LOW_COUNTS_validation_screen == FALSE &  LOW_COUNTS_primary_screen == FALSE, "driver",
                               ifelse(mutation_type == "synonymous" , "synonymous",
                                                        ifelse(mutation_type == "non_targeting", "non_targeting",
                                   lib_class))))
```

```{r}
#make a dot plot graph of resistance mutations
df_long_zscore <- 
  join_data_filtered_editing %>%
  select(id, gene, amino_acid_position, sequence_name, mutation_type, mutation, L2FC_A427_PE_FLARE_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_BI_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_MRTX_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_RMC_T0_Par_average_zscore, L2FC_A427_PE_ACBI3_T0_Par_average_zscore) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, sequence_name, gene, mutation, mutation_type, amino_acid_position), names_to = "drug", values_to = "z_score") %>%
  distinct()

df_long_editing <- 
  join_data_filtered_editing %>%
  select(id, gene, amino_acid_position, sequence_name, mutation, mutation_type, A427_PE_FLARE_Lib_sorted_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_RMC_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_BI_2865_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_MRTX_end_average_corrected_editing, A427_PE_Lib_ACBI3_end_average_corrected_editing) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, sequence_name, gene, mutation, mutation_type, amino_acid_position), names_to = "drug", values_to = "editing") %>%
  distinct()

df_long_zscore <-
  df_long_zscore %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_FLARE_"), "control", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_BI_"), "BI-2865", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_MRTX_"), "MRTX1133", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_RMC_"), "RMC-6236", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_ACBI3_"), "ACBI3", drug))

df_long_editing <-
  df_long_editing %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_FLARE_"), "control", drug)) %>%
    mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_BI_"), "BI-2865", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_MRTX_"), "MRTX1133", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_RMC_"), "RMC-6236", drug)) %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(str_detect(drug, "_ACBI3_"), "ACBI3", drug))

#join editing and zscore
df_long <- 
  left_join(df_long_zscore, df_long_editing)

df_long <-
  df_long %>%
  mutate(mutation_id = paste(gene, mutation, id)) %>%
  distinct()

df_long
```

```{r}
#coverage estimation for both PE and ABE
PE_coverage <- as_tibble(read.csv("coverage_PE.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))
BE_coverage <- as_tibble(read.csv("coverage_BE.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE))

BE_coverage <-
  BE_coverage %>%
  select(Protein_Position, Gene, most_severe_consequence) %>%
  rename(amino_acid_position = Protein_Position) %>%
  rename(mutation_type = most_severe_consequence) %>%
  filter(mutation_type != "synonymous") %>%
    rename(gene = Gene) %>%
  arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  distinct()

BE_coverage

PE_coverage <-
  PE_coverage %>%
  select(amino_acid_position, gene, mutation_type) %>%
    filter(mutation_type != "synonymous") %>%
  arrange(amino_acid_position) %>%
  distinct()

PE_coverage
```

```{r}
# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 189 residues)
#ABE
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position))

#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table with the gRNAs by Protein_Position
Coverage_ABE <-
  left_join(Protein, BE_coverage)
Coverage_ABE

#identify the number of missing amino acids (NA gRNA)
Missing <- 
  Coverage_ABE %>%
  filter(is.na(gene) == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::count()

#calculate the % coverage by non-synonymous amino acid mutations with CBE and ABE
(Length-Missing)/Length*100
```
```{r}
# define protein of interest "Protein" length in amino acids from Uniprot (here e.g. is 189 residues)
#PE
Length <- 189
Protein <- data.frame(amino_acid_position = 1:Length) %>%
  mutate(amino_acid_position = as.numeric(amino_acid_position))

#join the reference amino acid table to the coverage table with the gRNAs by Protein_Position
Coverage_PE <-
  left_join(Protein, PE_coverage)
Coverage_PE

#identify the number of missing amino acids (NA gRNA)
Missing <- 
  Coverage_PE %>%
  filter(is.na(gene) == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::count()

#calculate the % coverage by non-synonymous amino acid mutations with CBE and ABE
(Length-Missing)/Length*100
```

```{r}
#get rid of duplicates in mutation_type
Coverage_PE <-
  Coverage_PE %>%
  select(!mutation_type) %>%
  distinct()

Coverage_ABE <-
  Coverage_ABE %>%
  select(!mutation_type) %>%
  distinct()

Coverage_PE <-
  Coverage_PE %>%
  rename(gene_PE = gene)

Coverage_ABE <-
  Coverage_ABE %>%
  rename(gene_ABE = gene)

#join
#only missing in KRAS for PE
left_join(Coverage_PE, Coverage_ABE) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(is.na(gene_PE)) %>%
  count()

#only missing in KRAS for ABE
left_join(Coverage_PE, Coverage_ABE) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(is.na(gene_ABE)) %>%
  count()

#missing in both ABE and PE
left_join(Coverage_PE, Coverage_ABE) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(is.na(gene_ABE) & is.na(gene_PE)) %>%
    count()
```

```{r}
#MAGeCK analysis 
# List all _combined.sgrna_summary.txt files
file_list <- list.files(
  path = "MAGeCK_8132/combined/",
  pattern = "_combined\\.sgrna_summary\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

read_and_prepare <- function(file) {
  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>%
    str_remove("_combined\\.sgrna_summary\\.txt$")

  prefix <- paste0(sample_name, "_MAGeCK_")

  read_delim(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename(id = sgrna, gene = Gene) %>%
    # Prefix every column except id + gene
    rename_with(~ paste0(prefix, .x), -c(id, gene))
}

# Join all tables
MAGeCK <- file_list %>%
  map(read_and_prepare) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = c("id", "gene"))

MAGeCK
```

```{r}
#make a function to make a mutated amplicon sequence called mut_amp by substituting in the sensor_mut sequence

#' Inject a 1-bp mutation (given as sensor_mut) into a longer WT amplicon sequence.
inject_mut <- function(wt_amp, sensor_mut, max_mismatch = 1L) {

  # ---- Basic NA / sanity checks ----
  # If either sequence is missing, we can't do anything.
  if (is.na(wt_amp) || is.na(sensor_mut)) return(NA_character_)

  # L = length of the sensor sequence, N = length of the WT amplicon
  L <- str_length(sensor_mut)
  N <- str_length(wt_amp)

  # If sensor is empty or longer than the WT amplicon, replacement is impossible.
  if (L == 0L || N < L) return(NA_character_)

  # ---- Generate all candidate alignments (sliding window) ----
  # All possible start positions of an L-bp window within the N-bp wt_amp.
  # Example: if N=250 and L=54, starts will be 1:(250-54+1) = 1:197.
  starts <- seq_len(N - L + 1L)

  # Extract every L-bp window from wt_amp at each start position.
  # windows[i] = wt_amp[ starts[i] : (starts[i] + L - 1) ]
  windows <- str_sub(wt_amp, starts, starts + L - 1L)

  # ---- Compute mismatch counts (Hamming distance) ----
  # Convert sensor_mut into integer codes (A/C/G/T become integers via UTF-8 codes).
  # This lets us compare position-by-position cheaply.
  mut_int <- utf8ToInt(sensor_mut)

  # For each window, count how many positions differ from sensor_mut.
  # Hamming distance = sum(window[j] != sensor_mut[j]) across j = 1..L.
  d <- map_int(
    windows,
    ~ sum(utf8ToInt(.x) != mut_int)
  )

  # ---- Choose the best matching window ----
  # m = the smallest mismatch count observed across all windows.
  m <- min(d)

  # idx = which window(s) achieve that smallest mismatch count
  idx <- which(d == m)

  # Require:
  #   1) a unique best hit (length(idx) == 1), otherwise ambiguous location
  #   2) best mismatch count <= max_mismatch (expect m == 1 in your scenario)
  if (length(idx) != 1L || m > max_mismatch) return(NA_character_)

  # ---- Rebuild the amplicon with sensor_mut substituted in ----
  # Start/end coordinates of the best-matching window in the WT amplicon
  s <- starts[idx]
  e <- s + L - 1L

  # Construct: left flank + mutated sensor + right flank
  # - left flank: bases before s
  # - mutated sensor: sensor_mut
  # - right flank: bases after e
  str_c(
    str_sub(wt_amp, 1, s - 1L),
    sensor_mut,
    str_sub(wt_amp, e + 1L, -1L)
  )
}

# Apply rowwise using purrr::map2_chr to create the new mut_amp column
QUANTS <- 
  QUANTS %>%
  mutate(
    mut_amp = map2_chr(WT_amp, sensor_mut, inject_mut))

#this now contains the PCR amplicon sequence with the intended edit (extracted from the mutated sensor sequence match)
QUANTS
```

```{r}
      mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut4")) %>%
        mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "mut4")) %>%

          mutate(mutation = str_remove_all(mutation, "_2")) %>%
  filter(mutation != "G12R") %>% #not possible from the A427 cell model

  distinct()
```

```{r}
#need to reverse complement exon 2 and 3 for the Miseq output 
QUANTS %>%
  select(mutation, mut_amp, exon) %>%
  arrange(exon) %>%
  mutate(mut_amp = ifelse(exon == "exon4", mut_amp, 
         ifelse(exon == "exon2", str_to_upper(reverseComplement(mut_amp)), 
                ifelse(exon == "exon3", str_to_upper(reverseComplement(mut_amp)), mut_amp)))) %>%
  distinct() %>%
```
